To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we introduce a new coherent state formalism that is based on graph change and is useful in the context of polymer quantization.

We have constructed a new family of states for quantum theories obtained by applying the polymer quantization, which we call the graph states, which take the form of a Fock-like superposition of basis states with different graphs, and that these states are well-defined and have interesting properties.
We introduce a new family of quantum coherent states for quantum connection theories obtained from the polymer quantization and we study their properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of coherent states for the connection formulation of gauge theories and gravity.
the study of the dynamics of quantum field theories in the presence of constraints.
the study of quantum field theories in the framework of loop quantum gravity and its applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the graph coherent states are the most general coherent states that can be constructed in the context of the polymer quantization of gauge theories.
the graph coherent states are a natural generalization of the coherent states for the polymer quantum theory of connection.
the graph coherent states are the natural generalization of the coherent states of the connection theories to the case where the underlying graphs of the states are not necessarily fixed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the graph coherent states are a natural extension of the standard coherent states in connection quantum theories.
the graph coherent states provide a new tool for the study of quantum gravity and Yang-Mills theories.
we introduce a new family of polymer coherent states that can be used for a variety of applications, including the construction of polymer path integral and the study of polymer quantum field theory.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the graph coherent states are a natural and powerful tool to study quantum dynamics in the context of polymer quantum theories.
, in the context of the polymer approach to quantum gravity, the notion of graph is fundamental in the construction of the quantum states.
the graph coherent states are a natural and powerful way to describe the quantum dynamics of connections.
